biodegradable.recommended_action: Send for appropriate organic waste processing.

recyclable.recommended_action: Send to an appropriate recycling or processing channel.

non_recyclable.handling: Keep non-recyclable waste separate from recyclable material.
non_recyclable.recommended_action: Send through the appropriate municipal waste-management channel.

hazardous.handling: Do not mix hazardous waste with ordinary household waste.
hazardous.recommended_action: Use an appropriate hazardous-waste handling channel.

electronic.handling: Do not mix electronic waste with ordinary solid waste.
electronic.recommended_action: Use an appropriate e-waste collection and management channel.

other.handling: Identify the material before deciding the disposal method.
other.recommended_action: Use the appropriate waste-management channel based on the material.
